title: The wandering jew
html_source:
A mythical figure from medieval Christian tradition. He was a witness to Christ’s crucifixion. Because he taunted Jesus, he was cursed to walk the earth until the Second Coming.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wandering_Jew

Mulligan is being anti-Semitic. However, in a more literal sense, we know that Bloom has spent and will continue to spend his day wandering about Dublin.
